headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of August 24, 2026, the portfolio is showing a year-to-date return of 23.36%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark return of 12.67%. This results in an average alpha of 10.69%, indicating that the portfolio is not only gaining in absolute terms but is also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has achieved a remarkable return of 45.93%, contributing positively to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', returned 9.49%, highlighting the variance in performance across the portfolio set. This outperformance relative to SPY is particularly noteworthy during periods of market uncertainty, as it suggests resilience and effective management. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
